verdict.rationale: Kommo documents an official "WEB SDK" for building custom scripts, styles and widgets inside the Kommo interface, and a VoIP API that ships JavaScript methods and libraries. Both are first-party SDK-style tooling, but they cover only UI and widget extension and telephony. The core CRM API is described as a REST API, with no language client libraries evidenced and no OpenAPI spec found for generating one. missing for 10: official language client SDKs for the CRM API (e.g., Python/Node/PHP packages), a published OpenAPI spec for SDK generation, SDK reference depth and versioning, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: WEB SDK allows you to modify Kommo interface by introducing custom scripts and styles or creating widgets.
VoIP API is a set of JavaScript methods and libraries, like call record players, push notifications and others, as well as specific API and usage examples.
